This stunning new construction home in the prestigious Port Royal neighborhood blends modern elegance with serene waterfront views of Hidden Bay. Crafted by Kukk Architecture & Design and built by Wilbrett Construction, it features exquisite interiors by Adelyn Charles Interiors and offers a sophisticated yet relaxed living experience. The floor plan balances spacious communal areas with private retreats. The primary suite on the main floor boasts posh walk-in closets, a spa-like bath, and an executive study. Four guest ensuites on the upper floor and a large bonus room with a wet bar and a second laundry area ensure comfort. Guests will enjoy dolphin sightings and boat views from the open-air balcony. Premium finishes abound, including quality bespoke cabinetry, European hardwood floors, and top-of-the-line Wolfe, Sub-Zero, and Miele appliances. Built with superior techniques, the home features full concrete construction, Andersen impact windows and doors, an elevator from the garage level, remote-controlled screens and shutters, and a whole-house generator. Car enthusiasts will appreciate the oversized three-car garage with room for lifts and an additional bay for a low-speed vehicle. The resort-style infinity pool, spa, covered lanai, summer kitchen, firepit, and lounge area create a perfect outdoor haven. Eligibility for an exclusive 
Port Royal Club Resident Membership is included.

similar.Description: Available Seasonally ($40,000/month) and Annually ($21,000/month). Nestled in Naples’ most prestigious neighborhood, this stunning Port Royal residence offers the ultimate in coastal luxury—just minutes from the sugar-sand beaches of the Gulf of Mexico and the upscale boutiques and fine dining of iconic Third Street South. Designed with a modern coastal aesthetic, this contemporary home features an open-concept layout with 5 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and a private study. The chef’s kitchen is the heart of the home, seamlessly flowing into the spacious family room with unobstructed views of the sparkling pool and expansive outdoor living area. Walls of windows bathe the home in natural light from sunrise to sunset, creating an airy, inviting ambiance. The cozy living room showcases rich hardwood floors, coffered ceilings, and French doors that open to the backyard oasis. The luxurious primary suite is a private retreat, complete with bay windows, a sitting area, a king-sized bed, direct access to the pool, and a generous walk-in closet. The spa-inspired en-suite bathroom boasts a soaking tub, an oversized walk-in shower, dual vanities, and ample storage. Guests will enjoy the comfort of four additional bedrooms, thoughtfully outfitted with an additional king bed, a queen bed, a full Murphy bed, and twin beds to accommodate everyone with ease. Just outside is your private backyard sanctuary, where there is a beautiful pool, abundant seating, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen. Luxury and elegance await, Live Exceptionally in Port Royal.

similar.Description: Perfectly positioned along the tranquil waters of Runaway Bay, this beautifully reimagined Port Royal residence offers an elegant blend of contemporary refinement and timeless sophistication. The interiors were thoughtfully transformed with clean, modern finishes, curated fixtures, and exceptional attention to detail—reflecting a globally inspired design aesthetic. A remarkable entry foyer with a striking stairway sets an impressive tone upon arrival, leading to an array of beautifully proportioned living spaces. The formal living and dining rooms are gorgeous and light-filled, while a cozy den with custom built-in shelving provides a warm, intimate retreat. The renovated kitchen, appointed with Ruffino cabinetry and thoughtful upgrades, flows effortlessly into a functional family room and the expansive covered outdoor living area. A custom glass wine room adds a focal point and a touch of understated luxury. The home’s highly functional configuration includes six spacious bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom. The first-floor primary suite offers convenience and privacy, while five additional guest suites are located upstairs along with a large exercise room and a secondary loft office. Upgraded bathrooms throughout further elevate the home’s contemporary feel. Situated on a unique and well-proportioned Port Royal lot, the property features a spacious three-car garage with a large motor court and enjoys an exceptional position on sought-after Spyglass Lane. Boaters will appreciate the property’s no-bridge access to Naples Bay, the Gulf, and the surrounding estuarine waterways. The home’s elevated living experience is further enhanced by updated lighting and AV controls, security cameras, and motorized window shades. An outstanding opportunity to secure a residence in Port Royal ahead of the highly anticipated new Port Royal Club beachfront clubhouse, slated for completion in late 2026. This property is eligible for Port Royal Club membership.

IMMEDIATE RESIDENT FULL PORT ROYAL MEMBERSHIP! Perched against the stunning backdrop of Champney Bay, this exquisite property, inspired by the aesthetics of the French West Indies, has been thoughtfully designed by the acclaimed architect Jeff Harrell. After an extensive two-year whole home renovation completed in 2022, the estate underwent a comprehensive outdoor and lower-level renovation in 2024, executed by the esteemed Knauf-Koenig Group. This remarkable multi-structure Port Royal residence boasts five bedrooms, a den, and 6.5 bathrooms, masterfully fusing timeless elegance with modern luxuries. Upon entering this captivating home, you are immediately surrounded by an array of ultra high-end finishes and contemporary details, creating an ambiance of refined sophistication throughout. The gourmet kitchen is a culinary dream, featuring premium Officine Gullo and Gaggenau appliances. The stunning primary suite, which occupies an entire level, serves as a personal retreat. It offers a private waterfront balcony, expansive mahogany walk-in closets, a convenient morning kitchen, and a lavish bathroom adorned with an exquisite mother-of-pearl domed ceiling, cultivating a serene yet luxurious atmosphere. The outdoor areas are reminiscent of a high-end resort, showcasing a magnificent pool, a peaceful koi pond, and a remarkable double-sided marble fireplace that enhances the natural beauty of the surroundings. The thoughtfully designed outdoor kitchen, private sandy beach cove in addition to private beach access off Gordon Dr, and various terraces provide an ideal setting for seamless entertaining amid lush tropical landscaping. Additionally, this home features private beach access and a dock located just a short distance from Gordon Pass allowing for direct access to the gulf, making it perfect for boating enthusiasts. For car aficionados, the estate features three garages with the capacity to accommodate up to nine vehicles or 13 vehicles with lifts. Residents enjoy exclusive membership eligibility to the prestigious Port Royal Club, adding yet another enticing aspect to this extraordinary property.
A rare and inspiring waterfront offering on Gordon Drive, showcasing wide, sweeping vistas across Champney Bay. Impeccably designed by Stofft Cooney Architects and built to exacting standards

Nestled in the heart of Port Royal, Naples most sought after neighborhood, this elegantly furnished home offers an unparalleled blend of luxury and comfort. Situated on a quiet street, this residence is just a short walk to the beach and minutes from fine dining, boutique shopping, and the vibrant atmosphere of 3rd Street South and 5th Avenue South. Designed for both relaxation and entertainment, the home features a screened lanai barbecue area, and expansive outdoor living spaces, perfect for hosting guests or enjoying serene Florida evenings. Available for both short-term and long-term lease this exceptional property presents rare opportunity to experience the finest in Naples living.

similar.Description: 440 Kings Town Drive is one of the most exceptional luxury rentals in all of Naples. From the moment you enter the residence, to the master suite and the second master, you will be mesmerized by sweeping water views. Coastal elegance is replete in every detail, including an executive chef's kitchen, an ultra-luxurious master suite, a massive sunroom with adjacent formal dining and formal living room. Furnished from Baer's Furniture luxury catalog. Each rental is concierge level, with weekly cleaning, maximum premium cable TV and security, all included. Boat dockage available with named insured policy.

similar.Description: Very seldom does an estate of this caliber come to the marketplace. A property constructed to endure, a generational home crafted with such quality, care, and precision that to begin the journey with the intention of selling simply wouldn’t make sense. Absolutely stunning materials were grafted in to this incredible, solid concrete structure by craftsmen from around the world¬–artisans, third- and fourth-generation maestros. Set on over 300 pilings with 10-inch poured concrete walls and floors, a 250 mph wind rating, a 200 KW whole-house generator, this home was created with longevity and timelessness in mind. Spanning 14,000 air-conditioned square feet and positioned on a rare, nearly 1 acre parcel, this property has no competition. An abundance of mahogany millwork, doors, and trim. Natural stones from Europe. True 24k gold leaf adorns the ceilings. Five fireplaces. Incredible frescoes. Venetian plasters. A master bedroom suite that is beyond description. Designed with a true guest house that is attached to the main home for ease of access. Spectacular bar/club room with incredible wine storage, and an incredible, mosaic pool that seems to have been relocated from Italy itself. Located just moments away from the eagerly anticipated $100 million new Port Royal Club and beach, and with coveted western exposure, the setting is truly idyllic. A sensational opportunity to acquire such a property.

Experience a rare opportunity to own a spectacular new construction estate in Port Royal, timed for completion alongside the highly anticipated new Port Royal Club. Perfectly positioned at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this exceptional property captures sweeping, wide-water western views over private Buccaneer Bay — offering breathtaking sunsets and 179 feet of total water frontage. Built to today’s highest construction standards, this architectural masterpiece is being constructed by Toscana Homes, with plans thoughtfully designed by Stofft Cooney Architects and interiors curated by Carrie Brigham Design. Every element reflects superior craftsmanship, timeless design, and refined coastal luxury. The first floor is a true entertainer’s dream, where every room enjoys stunning water views and seamless indoor-outdoor living. Two spacious living rooms, an elegant dining room flanked by a walk-in wine cellar and full bar, and expansive glass openings create a setting designed for both grand entertaining and relaxed waterfront living. The gourmet kitchen is outfitted with Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, custom Soho cabinetry, and a fully equipped walk-in prep kitchen to accommodate catered events or everyday ease. The primary suite is a private sanctuary, offering tranquil bay views and a spa-inspired bath featuring separate his-and-her bathrooms connected by an oversized walk-in shower, along with two generous walk-in closets. An additional guest suite and an expansive club room are also located on the main level — each overlooking the pool and sparkling bay beyond. Upstairs, four spacious en-suite guest bedrooms provide ultimate privacy and comfort. A second-level lounge offers a welcoming retreat for family and guests, complemented by a fully equipped fitness room and built-in sauna for a true resort-style experience. New construction opportunities with wide-water western exposure are exceedingly rare in Port Royal. Completion is anticipated for the end of 2026, with immediate Port Royal Club eligibility upon purchase — presenting a unique chance to secure both a legacy property and premier club access in one of the country's most prestigious waterfront communities.
